sentences.en: It's a complete mess, and it's getting on my nerves.
sentences.zh: 这完全是一团糟，真把我烦死了。

sentences.en: He had the nerve to take my car without asking.
sentences.zh: 他竟敢未经允许就开我的车。

sentences.en: He had the nerve to ask me to marry him.

senses.zh: （坚强的）意志，勇气：power of endurance；给予勇气，鼓励：give courage
